notes.title: STARNAUT Demo Now Live!
notes.content:
STARNAUT Demo Now Live!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704066/ae560bf18cf308c81b9e617834704321e7a7b9ff.jpg[/img]

This special demo lets you experience a unique tutorial stage not found in the full game.
It also features a prototype of the upcoming bonus system based on enemy defeats—so even players who’ve already completed the main game will find something new to enjoy!

And once you clear the tutorial... you just might receive a special message from Copiasu.

If you know someone on the fence, recommend the demo to them!

Note: Save data from the demo will not carry over to the full game.

notes.title: [Full Release] STARNAUT — Now Launched!
notes.content:
Thank you all for waiting so patiently.
The day has finally arrived.
[u][b]"Mythical Concept STARNAUT" is officially released today![/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704066/83216b2b86d19a333e20a833cfcbe8d5b9fee64e.png[/img]

Embark on a journey to rebuild a fallen Earth in this loop-style roguelike, where the world changes every 30 minutes.
Based on the feedback from our Steam Early Access players, we have reviewed and restructured the entire game.

▼ Highlights of the Full Release:

60 stages in total

49 types of weapons

22 playable characters

Full story now unlocked

English localization and improved performance

Perhaps this journey will reveal the connection between the world of El Shaddai and your own memories.

We invite you to experience this new "Mythical Concept" —
and we would be thrilled if you shared your impressions with us!

notes.title: [Urgent] Announcement Regarding Full Release
notes.content:
To everyone eagerly awaiting STARNAUT,

Currently, we are still awaiting approval from Valve for the final review, and the full release has not yet gone live.
We will proceed with the full release as soon as the approval is granted and everything is confirmed.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience and support.

notes.title: Finally, it will be released tomorrow, April 28!
notes.content:
Ladies and gentlemen, it's finally tomorrow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704066/f6e36923fee1c1f8503e73340bf63efeb4758222.jpg[/img]

The Mythos Concept Star Notebook is finally ready for full release on Steam.

It's been a process of trial and error over the past few years.
But the feedback, bug reports, and words of support we received during the Early Access period ......
all helped us in our development.

In the final version, we have completely adjusted the stage structure, enemy patterns, UI, weapon balance, and more.
In addition, please pay attention to the unexpected connection with "that character" in the story.

Your journey will surely change something.
See you in space tomorrow.

notes.title: Includes character profiles!First information also!
notes.content:
[b]Only 2 more days until the release[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704066/feac1f6e66dd5b9dde30eea3481b9b19d9c08629.jpg[/img]

Today, we introduce the characters!
Here is a sneak preview of their unique personalities 🚀.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704066/bf27273428b7a7acb92d676c31ecb118b290acf0.png[/img]

[b][u]Copiasu[/u][/b]

“All right, reset time! I‘m feeling great!”
The 8th Designer Baby created by Stella. Driven by the dream of one day becoming a Starnaut and meeting Stella, he continues fighting. However, he actually received that title from Stella right from the start—he simply is too shy to claim it himself. With his incredibly positive personality, he charges forward fearlessly, no matter what kind of enemies may stand in his way.

Likes	Toast when he’s late
Dislikes	Solitude



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704066/6ab34699d1e38c8b261f2fcc6fbb7271d76b34a6.png[/img]

[b][u]Stella[/u][/b]

“When in doubt, use your fists!”
The guide to Copiasu’s game journey. Originally created as the central AI brain of Seven Nights, she takes on an automatically generated form when emerging to the surface, which can change slightly each time. The form pictured is how she appeared in her first meeting with Copiasu, and is the version of her that Copiasu trusts and cherishes most as his beloved Stella. Stella tries to maintain this form for Copiasu as much as possible, although she finds it a bit chilly during the winter.

Likes	Kaiten sushi
Dislikes	Defeat



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704066/326b2b78fcc5e0cd1a3d9b1fb6406bb72749c683.png[/img]

[u][b]Wonderful[/b][/u]

“Hmm... WONDERFUL!”
The physical manifestation of Wonderful chat, an AI chatbot created after Stella. He once served as an aide to Copiasu, but has since devoted himself to serving as a support role in his original form as a chatbot AI. You may occasionally spot him in his physical form as he runs around the stage with Lost Data in hand. If you spot him, make sure to give him a punch!

Likes	Dry dorayaki
Dislikes	Being ignored



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704066/0fab0ffffde5e88a31ad081dc69637854be641fe.png[/img]

[u][b]Shopnaut[/b][/u]

“.........”
A cool and nihilistic arms dealer. Once you’ve saved up enough money, you can buy weapons from him. No matter what happens, he’s always around. He’s strict when it comes to money, but surprisingly nice, even holding sales from time to time. However, he never speaks.

Likes	Ultimate weapons
Dislikes	Being poor

notes.title: Our Top Weapon Picks & Dev-Recommended Builds!
notes.content:
Hello!
This is the STARNAUT development team.
Only 3 days left until launch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704066/efe857f84ac3e789c4c2c538a77e2d871a2d1a0a.jpg[/img]

Today, we’d like to share something fun to know before you start playing — a quick dive into weapon builds!

Quaker

We’d love to hear your thoughts and see what you come up with!

notes.title: STARNAUT full release date set & trailer released!
notes.content:
[h2]― A new experience with even more content to explore! ―  [/h2]

Since its initial Early Access release on Steam on February 14, 2024, STARNAUT has evolved 
through roughly 30 updates shaped by player feedback. Now, as part of the larger mythos 
connected to El Shaddai, we are pleased to announce that the full release is ready for launch on 
April 28—coinciding with the 14th Anniversary of El Shaddai!

[previewyoutube=aUFOhH3KmCs;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]Major Changes in the Full Release  [/h2]
Throughout Early Access, we’ve greatly expanded and refined the game by actively incorporating 
feedback from the player community. Here are some new additions players can experience in the 
full release of the game: 

[list]
[*] Stages: 18 → 60 
[*] Weapon Types: 25 → 49  
[*] Helmet Types: 12 → 22+  
[*] Enemy Types: 100 → 400+ 
[*] Lost Data (Added Content): Over 200 new Lost Data have been added.  
[*] Story Chapters: 11 → 53
[/list]


[h2]What is Mythical Concept STARNAUT?  [/h2]
Mythical Concept STARNAUT is a survivor-style action game with roguelike elements. Set in a 
multidimensional universe, players must battle through relentless waves of enemies, upgrade 
their weapons and equipment, and launch rockets to clear each stage. 
Set within the same mythological framework as El Shaddai, the game invites players to uncover 
its connected narrative and rich world interwoven with the El Shaddai mythos. Each playthrough 
takes roughly 30 minutes, offering a variety of different ways to build your character and evolving 
strategies that keep the gameplay experience fresh and rewarding. 
Key Features 
• Create a variety of combat styles by combining 49 unique weapons 
• Experience an evolving combat system as you dodge and strike back against the 
relentless attacks of over 100 different types 
• Enjoy roguelike gameplay that changes with each run for high replayability 
• Discover hidden lore about the sci-fi narrative of the game through collectable Lost Data 
After roughly 30 updates driven by community feedback during its Early Access, STARNAUT is 
ready for release with a massive expansion in content — featuring new weapons, stages, and 
story content for a deeper, more immersive experience.

To ensure the best experience possible, we are recruiting volunteers from our Early Access users to assist us.

Roles Available:

2. Promotion Support
3. Translation Check

Participation Requirements

Testing Period
　Until the official release date

You are free to use any recording method, such as your PC’s built-in recording function or your preferred recording software.
Please upload the recorded data to the designated Dropbox folder.

Your impressions of the game
Suggestions for the development team
Areas where explanations felt insufficient or improvement ideas

Please send an email expressing your interest in participating.

notes.title: "Mythos Project STARNAUT" Full Release Confirmed for November 9!
notes.content:
The full release of Mythos Project STARNAUT has been confirmed for November 9, following its early access launch on Steam in February 2024 and around 30 updates driven by user feedback. The content has been significantly enhanced to offer a unique and improved experience. That's exciting news! Let me know if you'd like help preparing any announcements or other details.


[b]Steam[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2508940/_/


[b]Trailer[/b]
https://youtu.be/NYI48EuuGYM?si=Y3MhYW54f5xdnIjG


[h3]Evolution Points of STARNAUT[/h3]
As part of the El Shaddai mythos, STARNAUT introduces an entirely new story. Additionally, the previously separate prequel novel Copiasu will now be included, offering fans a must-see collection of content packed with rich lore.
This makes STARNAUT even more enticing for fans of the mythos. Let me know if you'd like to further elaborate on any aspects or need help with anything else!

[h3]Main Changes in the Full Release[/h3]
[b]Stages: 10 → Over 30 types
Weapons: 24 → Over 48 types
Helmets: 14 → Over 20 types
Enemy Types: 100 → Over 400 types
Lost Data: Over 100 additional entries[/b]

[h3]Game Features[/h3]
STARNAUT is a replayable survivor action game, with each play session lasting about 30 minutes. Ultimately, players will experience a new mythological world deeply connected to El Shaddai.

[h3]Release Date and Special Significance[/h3]
The release date, November 9, is a special day known as "Enoch Day" among El Shaddai fans in Japan. On this day, a new door to the mythological world will open, allowing players to embark on an unprecedented adventure. Look forward to the full release of Star Note, which has been greatly expanded in content!

Note: The full release price will be announced at a later date.

notes.title: STARNAUT launches today🚀
notes.content:
🚀STARNAUT launches today🚀
STARNAUT launched today, Wednesday, 2/14, for Early Access.

STARNAUT  began development with three core members.

We started development with this conviction: "If you make a survivor-like game in 3D, it will be fun for sure!"
We began development with this conviction.
Sometimes we had fun, sometimes we stumbled, but we developed hard and our team grew.
As a result, I believe we have created a new form of game experience for you to enjoy.

However, the adventure of STARNAUT has just begun.

From now on,
Weekly updates of new content and
We are planning to update the game weekly with new content and to fix bugs and stabilize the game on a case-by-case basis.
We also have many other ideas that will be implemented as soon as they are ready.

We are convinced that STARNAUT is a game that has a lot of potential that we haven't seen yet.
We will do our best to update it,
With your help, we will be able to make the game even better than we could have predicted.

We would love to hear what you think of the game and your feedback.
Your feedback will help us make STARNAUT even better.
And if you would like to support us with a positive review, the development group would be very happy to hear from you.
We are just getting started, but we look forward to your continued support 🚀🚀 🚀🚀 🚀🚀 🚀🚀

STARNAUT Development Team
